acceptance_criteria.wikimedia_validation_loss: must improve relative to parent checkpoint
acceptance_criteria.fineweb_validation_loss: must not materially regress; review any relative increase above 2%
acceptance_criteria.generation_quality: must not collapse on the existing fixed prompt suite
acceptance_criteria.style: must not default to article headings or citation-like prose
acceptance_criteria.factuality: must improve or remain stable under manual and automatic review

contamination_policy: Prompts are category-level questions and do not copy source-release sentences.
